text:
ITEM 1 | Wedge-shaped slice of baked flatbread-like crust, golden to orange-red top with melted orange cheese and bubbled spots, sitting at upper left of plate, roughly 9 cm long by 6 cm wide, about 1.5 cm thick at crust edge, with a tomato slice and thin red onion rings on top | 110
ITEM 2 | Round tomato slice, bright red with pale seed-pocket centre, about 4 cm diameter, partly under and on top of the cheese crust, moist and glossy | 20
ITEM 3 | Thin red onion rings, pale pink-white with purple edges, scattered under the pizza slice, about 3 cm long pieces, moist and limp | 5
ITEM 4 | Mixed dark green leafy greens, wilted and matte with some glossy spots, spread in a loose heap under and beside the crust, leaves about 4 to 6 cm long | 45
ITEM 5 | Cucumber pieces, pale green with white flesh edges, cut into irregular cubes and chunks about 1.5 to 2 cm, crisp-looking and moist, scattered at top center and lower left | 40
ITEM 6 | Pale green chopped vegetable pieces, slightly translucent, cut into small cubes about 1 cm, lower left of plate beside the greens | 15
ITEM 7 | Cooked white poultry-like pieces, pale off-white with fibrous shredded texture, irregular chunks about 3 cm, sitting on the right beside the spinach, slightly moist with a light sheen | 30
ITEM 8 | Fresh spinach-type leaves, deep green with visible veins, glossy and slightly wet, scattered across right side of plate, leaves about 6 to 8 cm long | 35
ITEM 9 | Light cream-colored crumbly cheese crumbles, dry and speckled, scattered over greens on right side | 8
ITEM 10 | Small toasted nut pieces, golden brown and irregular, about 0.5 cm, scattered over the right-side greens | 5
ITEM 11 | Light dressing or oil film, glossy translucent sheen on the leaves on right side, no pooled liquid visible | 5
